short: A five-year soldier-emperor who reunited an empire that had split into three separate states.
full:
Aurelian rose through the army to the throne in September 270 CE, inheriting an empire fractured into the breakaway Gallic Empire in the west and the Palmyrene Empire in the east, alongside continuing invasions across the Rhine and Danube. He first cleared Italy of Germanic raiders and shortened Rome's frontier by abandoning the exposed province of Dacia, then turned east.

Between 272 and 274 CE he defeated Palmyra and captured its queen Zenobia, then marched west and forced the surrender of the Gallic Empire without a major battle, reuniting the Roman world under one ruler for the first time in over a decade. The Senate honoured him as Restorer of the World. Aurelian was murdered by his own officers near Byzantium in September 275 CE, the victim of a secretary's forged death list, but his reunification held and set the pattern Diocletian would later formalise.
